item.title: The History of Chole Bhature | How 1947 Shaped Delhi’s Soul Food
item.description: #thebetterindia Born from the chaos of 1947, Chole Bhature is more than a meal—it is the historical heartbeat of Delhi street food. The journey of this dish began in the refugee kitchens of West Punjab. Following the Partition, it transitioned to the iconic stalls of Connaught Place (CP), serving as a vital, affordable survival meal for migrants rebuilding their lives.
